item.title: WATCH: What are the roads like in the Piedmont Triad on Saturday?
item.description: PIEDMONT TRIAD, N.C. (WGHP) — Snow fell across several parts of the Piedmont Triad. FOX8 Crews are stationed across the Triad, giving you live reports of the road conditions across the region. Driving conditions remain dangerous as snow masks the ice already sitting on roads due to last weekend's snowstorm.
